tickets.title: Address Mira’s six-month cash reserve and remaining lease impact
tickets.text: Review Mira’s six-month cash reserve preference and the impact of Mira’s remaining apartment rent. Address the shortfall caused by wedding costs, Mira’s remaining apartment rent, and the combined monthly spending estimate.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.

tickets.title: Update Mira’s household profile and address records
tickets.text: Update Mira’s household profile and address records to reflect the shared household while preserving Mira’s preferred separate ownership notes for premarital accounts.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-06 is to update the household profile and address records.

tickets.title: Obtain Mira’s marriage certificate
tickets.text: Obtain Mira’s marriage certificate for account registration, beneficiary, and name-related records. The custodian and insurance carriers may require a certified or scanned copy. Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have a copy in the client file.
tickets.evidence: follow-up is needed by 2024-02-28 to obtain marriage certificate evidence.

tickets.title: Provide Mira’s taxable account registration options
tickets.text: Provide Mira with paperwork and a plain-language comparison for keeping her Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account individually titled versus opening a new joint account for future household savings.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-01 is to provide the taxable account registration options.

tickets.title: Address Mira’s online access for a spouse and household view
tickets.text: Address Mira’s request for Arlen’s view-only access to the household dashboard without giving him trading authority over her individual IRA and taxable accounts.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-29 is to address online access for a spouse and household view.

tickets.title: Address Mira’s Velvet Acorn Custody beneficiary update error
tickets.text: Address Mira’s failed attempt to add Arlen as a contingent beneficiary on Velvet Acorn Custody’s website. The failed session did not produce a confirmation number.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-02-27 is to address the custodian beneficiary update error.

tickets.title: Review Mira and Arlen’s employer benefit elections
tickets.text: Review Mira’s Clockwork Clover Robotics newlywed enrollment window and Arlen’s Paper Otter Preparatory benefit-change process for medical, life, and disability coverage choices for the combined household.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-05 is to review employer benefit elections.

tickets.title: Review Mira and Arlen’s life and disability coverage alignment
tickets.text: Review Mira’s individual term policy, Mira’s group life coverage, Arlen’s term policy, and Arlen’s employer coverage for beneficiary records and replacement-income assumptions for the new household.
tickets.evidence: follow-up is needed by 2024-03-14 on life and disability coverage alignment.

tickets.title: Collect Mira and Arlen’s estate document copies and amendment pages
tickets.text: Collect Mira’s and Arlen’s estate document copies and any amendment pages. Mira signed a will and financial power of attorney in 2018 before the marriage. Arlen signed a will in 2016 after Pippa was born. Mossy Meteor Advisory did not have copies of the signed documents or any amendment pages in its planning record.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-12 is to collect estate document copies and any amendment pages.

tickets.title: Review Mira and Arlen’s mortgage and property records
tickets.text: Review Mira and Arlen’s mortgage and property records. The current mortgage statement, deed vesting page, and homeowner policy declarations were not available.
tickets.evidence: Follow-up is needed by 2024-03-15 for the mortgage and property record review based on those missing property records.

tickets.title: Prepare Mira and Arlen’s joint tax withholding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated 2024 withholding and estimated-tax projection for Mira and Arlen to share with Celia Fablethimble of Apricot Compass Tax. The marriage combines two salaries, bonuses, investment income, and Mira’s capital loss carryforward.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-04-05 is to prepare the joint tax withholding projection.
